sections.what_happened: Friday morning at Yehuda Junction outside Hebron: 2 IDF soldiers killed (Staff Sgt. Ron Yonatan Roytman 23, Sgt. Yuval Shai Svilem 20), 3 wounded; 2 Palestinian gunmen (Firas and Hamouda al-Jaaba, Hebron) killed, armed with M4 rifle and handgun. Friday night IDF announced a 'limited counterterrorism operation' in Hebron expected to last several days: precise house searches, suspect questioning, residents exit only via 3 designated checkpoints after screening. Netanyahu visited Hebron, ordered the city sealed and the full West Bank locked down (full closure now active), pledged house-to-house raids and home demolitions ('We will clear out the residents, go house to house'), vowed to 'pursue Hamas terrorists everywhere'. Raids also in Nablus, Tubas, Qalqilya (Al Mayadeen). Hamas praised the attack (Particle). UN: 'extremely alarmed' (Dujarric/Guterres); OHCHR: closures 'suffocating measures', >160 settler attacks in October. AFP tally: 1,113 Palestinians killed in West Bank since Oct 2023; 49 Israelis killed. Israeli election in 3 days (Oct 27).
sections.what_verified: IDF primary statements (casualty IDs, operation announcement) carried across Haaretz (Reuters photos), AFP via Manila Times, Al Jazeera liveblog (real aljazeera.com, updated 04:50 UTC Oct 24), The Guardian, Al-Monitor, Jerusalem Post, Republic World, Economic Times; UN statements via UN spokesperson + UrduPoint/APP; operation details consistent across families; Netanyahu quotes consistent across families. Counter-narrative present: Hamas praise vs IDF 'terror' framing; false-flag claims in social comments are unsupported.
sections.what_disputed: Hamas praised the attack (attributed via Particle news); IDF narrative of a thwarted 'terror attack' vs Palestinian framing of occupation resistance; social-media false-flag accusations (no evidence). Exact scope of threatened demolitions (which houses) not yet documented by UN.
sections.why_matters: Days before the Oct-27 election, Israel seals 3 million people over one gunfight -- the 4th full West Bank lockdown in a month. Counterterrorism or collective punishment?
